critical.issue: CWE filter parameter is SILENTLY IGNORED by list_findings — there is no `cwe: Optional[str]` parameter in /app/backend/routes/findings.py line ~20-36. The Dashboard 'CWE Prevalence' link navigates to /findings?cwe=CWE-1022 but backend returns ALL 6854 findings (total unchanged); however the frontend Findings page also filters client-side and renders 0 rows because no finding documents have a populated `cwe` field. Net result: CWE drill-down is non-functional. Fix: add `cwe: Optional[str] = None` query param and `if cwe: flt['cwe'] = cwe`, AND ensure findings ingestion populates `cwe` field (currently null for Qualys imports).

minor.issue: Returns 404 Not Found — only /v1/attack-paths/cves and /v1/attack-paths/graph exist. Frontend currently does not call the bare path, so cosmetic, but worth a 404→redirect/index endpoint.
4 x 401 'Failed to load resource' console errors on first page load after login — likely a stale unauthenticated fetch fired before token attached. Not blocking but produces noise.

rca of the issue: CWE drill-down end-to-end gap has TWO causes: (a) /v1/findings list endpoint has no `cwe` query parameter — the param is silently dropped (FastAPI ignores unknown query params), so backend returns the full result set; (b) finding docs from Qualys ingestion never set a `cwe` field, so even a correct backend filter would return 0. Fix needs both: add the filter AND backfill/populate cwe on import. Reproduce: GET /api/v1/findings?cwe=CWE-1022 returns total=6854 (same as no filter); count of findings where `cwe` field is non-null = 0.
